data.review_body:
on 25. june I made an order of 35 products and 115€ in total. Later on i got an email saying i got the package on the day i was home, reached out to temu saying i did not get the package. after asking me the declaration of non receipt 3 times, and i sent it every time , they did not help and all of a sudden told me to contact postnl. and then postnl told me to contact temu. they definitely did not do anything just to ask the form and then they closed the ticket. now i dont have any products and i just spent 115 euros just to have troubles with postnl and temu. 
now they are saying it has been long time and according to their policy they can not pay back. all this time i have been waiting for them to solve the issue and sending them what they exactly need?  very bad customer service.
data.review_headline: ticket not solved, horrible customer service

data.review_body:
Would give zero stars if possible.  Incorrect item sent so requested a return for refund - didn’t unpack the item as it was clearly incorrect so sealed up the parcel and relabeled for return.  Return was received but got a message stating that I had sent back the wrong item so refund was refused.  Customer service were no help despite me sending photos to prove the wrong item had been received - not sure how they expected me to return something that I hadn’t been sent.
Will definitely not use TEMU again - total scammers
data.review_headline: Would give zero stars if possible

DO NOT BUY OFF THESE ROUGES.

data.review_body: my parcel was delivered to the wrong address and I don't know where but the evri driver took a picture of it delivered outside of a block of flats not where I live and this was taken as proof of delivery and temu refused to refund me whilst evri just don't contact anyone so I'll be leaving a review for them as well but it seems i have no other options available and just have to accept the fact I'm not going to get my money back or the items purchased..i will never buy anything else from them and would certainly advise anyone doing so that you might end up losing your money.. absolutely awful service .. further to this i have contacted temu again and again only to get the same response i have other deliveries that should arrive today and still more on the way and not hopeful of getting them the reply shown here to contact temu again just seems to make it look like they are actually going to do something about it but I have been on there this morning and still got nowhere but I'll try yet again and update this accordingly .. well gave them another chance as they asked me to in the reply to this and after so many messages it's exactly the same no refund and looking at the delivery picture it's slightly blurred and you can't see sny numbers so I really couldn't say which block of flats it was delivered to but apparently that's proof of delivery but where it was delivered is another matter unbelievably I was asked to provide proof that it was either stolen or not received WTF.. how do I give them proof of this.. anyway if you use temu just be aware that this could happen and I hope you have a better experience than me.. although I wouldn't ever buy anything else from them and my family members have looked at the messages and were absolutely appalled so deleted temu .. I'm 64 yrs old and disabled due to serious illness i can't go around looking for parcels that are delivered elsewhere i have to get help to do so and like all of us can't afford to just throw money away.. even further information is that now another 2 parcels have gone missing delivered elsewhere and still temu refuse to refund or replace.. this is evri not delivering the items but it's also temu refusing to act or help in any way just an awful company i wouldn't use them again and if you have any issues with things beig delivered properly i would advise you not to use them either.. Amazon may be more expensive but they do look at the delivery and accept it wasn't made and they contact delivery companies on your behalf and give you refunds if necessary.. this is because they accept that the responsibility towards their customers is important temu do not they just take your money and don't care if you get the items you paid for or not... just a final note that advertised buyer protection is absolute pile of crap
data.review_headline: delivered to wrong address and refused money back awful service
